title: TX3 Inline Kafka 발행 Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan to replace AFTER_COMMIT event publishing with inline kafkaTemplate.send() at end of TX3, deleting failed_kafka_event machinery.
notes: Implementation plan under /plans/ with numbered Tasks/Steps, code blocks, and file map. No ADR Status/Decision/Consequences structure, no PRD user stories/acceptance criteria, no SPEC contract/schema tables. Architectural rationale is embedded but framed as a build guide → DOC. Contains a design decision (inline publish vs AFTER_COMMIT) that a synthesizer may want to trace back to an ADR.
